desc:
<A:N16> is the most common move as well as the traditional joseki.

<B:L17> is the most calm move and may be preferable if moving toward the upper left corner is important for White.

<C:M17> is also played.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 8, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Han Yizhou 5p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVmQ15D1pHs&t=301s) and [*Game 30, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Tang Weixing 9p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N9eVQX9kxJQ&t=181s).
